summary.text: Mike Lay is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 68 since 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Mike Lay was born in Tulsa, Oklahoma, and Ballotpedia lists business owner as his career experience.
He took office on November 20, 2024, succeeding Lonnie Sims.
Ballotpedia lists Michelle Lafleur as also running in the November 3, 2026 general election for District 68.
